job: Search a list or a page by typing.
purpose: An input with a leading icon. The clear button appears as soon as there is text and the key hint steps aside. data-fd-search-hotkey focuses the first visible search on "/" or on Cmd/Ctrl+K. The soft variant sits in toolbars next to filters; the white one suits a page whose main job is search.
useWhen: People filter or find items in a list, table or document.
A page has one main search that a keyboard shortcut should reach.

avoidWhen.when: The search runs commands or jumps between pages from anywhere.
The value is any other kind of text.
The person picks from a known list while typing.

states.name: has text
states.how: the clear button shows and the key hint hides

variants.useWhen: In a toolbar beside filters, where a white field would be loud.
A search that is the main job of the page.
A short search that sizes to its content.

parts.role: The clear button; shows when there is text.

keyboard.does: Focuses the first visible search marked data-fd-search-hotkey.
Focuses it when the hotkey is "mod+k".
Clears the text; with no text, leaves the field.
